name: Virginia Aquarium
tagline: Starter list: sharks, sea turtles, and the Jellies Gallery — otter habitat is vacant.

practical.ticket_note: Oceanfront area; wind and sun on outdoor paths.
practical.best_start: Indoor tanks if windy; aviary/boardwalk when mild.

items.label: Shark
items.one_liner: Nurse, sandbar, sand tiger, zebra, and catsharks.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Shark?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Sea turtle
items.one_liner: Green, Kemp’s, and loggerhead sea turtles.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Sea turtle?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Jellyfish
items.one_liner: Jellies Gallery plus a moon-jelly touch pool.
